title: Is manual software optimization a thing of the past?

paragraphs.en: Context: Scientific software is increasingly required to process larger datasets while maintaining acceptable execution times. Software optimization traditionally requires substantial expertise in programming, algorithms, and numerical methods. Recent advances in large language models (LLMs) offer the possibility of automating much of this process. Objectives: We investigate whether LLM-based agents can autonomously achieve substantial performance improvements in scientific software, including mature implementations that have already been extensively optimized by human developers. Methods: We tasked an LLM-based agent with optimizing software for three computational problems: t-SNE, single-sample gene set enrichment analysis (ssGSEA), and graphlet counting. Humans defined the scope, correctness criteria, and a verification mechanism, after which the agent worked autonomously, in some cases for several hours. Code maintainers reviewed each resulting implementation and verified its correctness. Results: The optimized implementations were faster in all tested configurations, by up to two orders of magnitude over the fastest existing tools. The improvements included low-level code optimizations, mathematical reformulations, and an entirely new algorithm for graphlet counting. Conclusion: Software optimization can increasingly be delegated to autonomous agents, with the human role shifting from implementing optimizations to deciding which software to optimize, defining objectives, providing verification mechanisms, and ensuring the correctness of the final software. For well-scoped, verifiable problems, we argue that manual software optimization may be a thing of the past.
paragraphs.zh: 背景：科学软件越来越需要处理更大的数据集，同时保持可接受的执行时间。 传统上，软件优化需要深厚的编程、算法和数值方法方面的专业知识。 大型语言模型（LLM）的最新进展为自动化这一过程的很大一部分提供了可能性。 目标：我们研究基于 LLM 的智能体是否能够自主实现科学软件的显著性能提升，包括那些已经由人类开发者广泛优化的成熟实现。 方法：我们让一个基于 LLM 的智能体针对三个计算问题优化软件：t-SNE、单样本基因集富集分析（ssGSEA）和图元计数。 人类定义了任务范围、正确性标准和验证机制，之后智能体便自主工作，某些情况下持续数小时。 代码维护者审查了每个生成的实现，并验证了其正确性。 结果：在所有测试的配置中，优化后的实现速度更快，与最快的现有工具相比，速度提升最高可达两个数量级。 这些改进包括底层代码优化、数学公式的重构，以及用于图元计数的全新算法。 结论：软件优化可以越来越多地委托给自主智能体，人类的角色将从实施优化转变为决定哪些软件需要优化、定义目标、提供验证机制并确保最终软件的正确性。 对于范围明确且可验证的问题，我们认为手动软件优化可能已成为过去。

paragraphs.en: K eywords Software optimization, Agentic optimization, Algorithmic complexity, Large language models .
paragraphs.zh: 关键词：软件优化、智能体优化、算法复杂度、大型语言模型。

paragraphs.en: Scientific research increasingly relies on software for data analysis, simulation, and other computational tasks ( 2 ) . As datasets grow, the efficiency of this software increasingly determines which analyses are feasible. Yet optimizing non-trivial scientific software requires expertise in software engineering, numerical computing, and algorithm design, as well as considerable development effort.
paragraphs.zh: 科学研究越来越依赖软件进行数据分析、模拟和其他计算任务 ( 2 )。 随着数据集的规模不断扩大，这类软件的效率在决定哪些分析可行方面变得越来越关键。 然而，要优化非简单的科学软件，需要掌握软件工程、数值计算和算法设计方面的专业知识，并投入大量的开发工作。

sents.en: Scientific research increasingly relies on software for data analysis, simulation, and other computational tasks ( 2 ) .
sents.zh: 科学研究越来越依赖软件进行数据分析、模拟和其他计算任务 ( 2 )。

sents.en: As datasets grow, the efficiency of this software increasingly determines which analyses are feasible.
sents.zh: 随着数据集的规模不断扩大，这类软件的效率在决定哪些分析可行方面变得越来越关键。

sents.en: Yet optimizing non-trivial scientific software requires expertise in software engineering, numerical computing, and algorithm design, as well as considerable development effort.
sents.zh: 然而，要优化非简单的科学软件，需要掌握软件工程、数值计算和算法设计方面的专业知识，并投入大量的开发工作。

paragraphs.en: Recent advances in large language models (LLMs) have enabled agents that can generate, modify, test, and benchmark software. Performance can be improved at different levels, from low-level code optimizations, such as better memory access patterns, vectorization, or parallelization, to reformulating the computation mathematically or replacing the algorithm altogether. Whether LLM agents can autonomously find improvements beyond the low-level ones, even for well-scoped problems with verifiable results, remains unclear, as existing evaluations report mostly surface-level gains ( 9 ) .
paragraphs.zh: 大型语言模型（LLM）的最新进展催生了能够生成、修改、测试和评估软件的智能体。 性能可以在不同层面得到提升，从低层级的代码优化（例如更高效的内存访问模式、向量化或并行化），到对计算过程进行数学重构，甚至完全替换算法。 LLM 智能体能否在有限范围且结果可验证的问题中，自主发现超越低层级优化的改进方案，目前仍不清楚，因为现有评估大多仅报告了表层性能的提升（9）。

sents.en: Recent advances in large language models (LLMs) have enabled agents that can generate, modify, test, and benchmark software.
sents.zh: 大型语言模型（LLM）的最新进展催生了能够生成、修改、测试和评估软件的智能体。

sents.en: Performance can be improved at different levels, from low-level code optimizations, such as better memory access patterns, vectorization, or parallelization, to reformulating the computation mathematically or replacing the algorithm altogether.

sents.en: Whether LLM agents can autonomously find improvements beyond the low-level ones, even for well-scoped problems with verifiable results, remains unclear, as existing evaluations report mostly surface-level gains ( 9 ) .

paragraphs.en: We investigate this question on three computational problems: t-SNE, single-sample gene set enrichment analysis (ssGSEA), and graphlet counting. In each case, humans defined the scope, correctness criteria, and a verification mechanism, after which an LLM agent worked without further intervention. The resulting implementations were faster in every case study, by up to two orders of magnitude over the fastest existing tools, with improvements spanning all three levels.
paragraphs.zh: 我们通过三个计算问题来研究这个问题：t-SNE、单样本基因集富集分析（ssGSEA）以及图元计数。 在每个案例中，人类都定义了范围、正确性标准和验证机制，之后 LLM 智能体在没有进一步干预的情况下完成工作。 在所有案例研究中，生成的实现方案都更快，与现有最快的工具相比，速度提升可达两个数量级，且改进覆盖了全部三个层面。

sents.en: We investigate this question on three computational problems: t-SNE, single-sample gene set enrichment analysis (ssGSEA), and graphlet counting.
sents.zh: 我们通过三个计算问题来研究这个问题：t-SNE、单样本基因集富集分析（ssGSEA）以及图元计数。

sents.en: In each case, humans defined the scope, correctness criteria, and a verification mechanism, after which an LLM agent worked without further intervention.
sents.zh: 在每个案例中，人类都定义了范围、正确性标准和验证机制，之后 LLM 智能体在没有进一步干预的情况下完成工作。

sents.en: The resulting implementations were faster in every case study, by up to two orders of magnitude over the fastest existing tools, with improvements spanning all three levels.
sents.zh: 在所有案例研究中，生成的实现方案都更快，与现有最快的工具相比，速度提升可达两个数量级，且改进覆盖了全部三个层面。

paragraphs.en: Early LLM-based optimizers wrapped the model in fixed pipelines. SysLLMatic ( 7 ) profiles a program to locate hotspots and rewrites them using a curated catalog of optimization patterns, while PIE ( 12 ) fine-tunes models on pairs of slower and faster C++ programs. Evolutionary systems that pair LLMs with automated evaluators have gone further, discovering new algorithms ( 6 ) . More recently, general-purpose coding agents have been applied to real scientific software, with the largest gains coming from rewriting code in faster languages or for GPUs ( 4 ) .
paragraphs.zh: 早期的基于大型语言模型（LLM）的优化器将模型封装在固定的流程中。 SysLLMatic (7) 会对程序进行剖析以定位性能热点，并使用精心挑选的优化模式目录对其进行重写；而 PIE (12) 则通过较慢和较快的 C++ 程序对进行对比来微调模型。 将大型语言模型（LLM）与自动评估器相结合的演化系统更进一步，成功发现了新的算法 (6)。 近期，通用型编码智能体已被应用于真实的科学软件中，其中最大的性能提升来自将代码改写为更高效的编程语言或针对 GPU 进行优化 (4)。

sents.en: Early LLM-based optimizers wrapped the model in fixed pipelines.
sents.zh: 早期的基于大型语言模型（LLM）的优化器将模型封装在固定的流程中。

sents.en: SysLLMatic ( 7 ) profiles a program to locate hotspots and rewrites them using a curated catalog of optimization patterns, while PIE ( 12 ) fine-tunes models on pairs of slower and faster C++ programs.
sents.zh: SysLLMatic (7) 会对程序进行剖析以定位性能热点，并使用精心挑选的优化模式目录对其进行重写；而 PIE (12) 则通过较慢和较快的 C++ 程序对进行对比来微调模型。

sents.en: Evolutionary systems that pair LLMs with automated evaluators have gone further, discovering new algorithms ( 6 ) .
sents.zh: 将大型语言模型（LLM）与自动评估器相结合的演化系统更进一步，成功发现了新的算法 (6)。

sents.en: More recently, general-purpose coding agents have been applied to real scientific software, with the largest gains coming from rewriting code in faster languages or for GPUs ( 4 ) .
sents.zh: 近期，通用型编码智能体已被应用于真实的科学软件中，其中最大的性能提升来自将代码改写为更高效的编程语言或针对 GPU 进行优化 (4)。

paragraphs.en: Nevertheless, the effectiveness of general-purpose LLM-based agents remains uncertain. On AlgoTune ( 9 ) , current models achieved only modest speedups over mature numerical libraries and failed to discover algorithmic improvements. On benchmarks built from real optimization commits in scientific Python libraries, agents reach less than a quarter of the expert speedup ( 5 ) , and other evaluations report negligible gains ( 11 ) . In contrast, we show that a general-purpose agent can reduce the expected asymptotic cost of a computation, outperform an expert-designed algorithm, and speed up mature, hand-optimized software several-fold in place.
paragraphs.zh: 然而，基于通用大型语言模型（LLM）的智能体的有效性仍然不确定。 在 AlgoTune (9) 上，当前模型仅比成熟的数值库实现了有限的加速，且未能发现算法上的改进。 在基于科学 Python 库中真实优化提交构建的基准测试中，智能体实现的加速效果不足专家水平的四分之一 (5)，而其他评估则报告了可忽略不计的提升 (11)。 相比之下，我们证明了一种通用智能体能够降低计算的预期渐近成本，超越专家设计的算法，并原地将成熟的手动优化软件加速数倍。

sents.zh: 然而，基于通用大型语言模型（LLM）的智能体的有效性仍然不确定。

sents.en: In contrast, we show that a general-purpose agent can reduce the expected asymptotic cost of a computation, outperform an expert-designed algorithm, and speed up mature, hand-optimized software several-fold in place.
sents.zh: 相比之下，我们证明了一种通用智能体能够降低计算的预期渐近成本，超越专家设计的算法，并原地将成熟的手动优化软件加速数倍。

paragraphs.en: To demonstrate that agentic software optimization extends beyond low-level code changes, we tasked Claude Opus 5, running in Claude Code, with either improving an existing implementation, producing a new, faster implementation of an existing algorithm, or producing a novel algorithm altogether for three real-world computational problems. Each implementation was reviewed by domain experts, including the original developers of openTSNE and Orca, and verified to be correct.
paragraphs.zh: 为了证明智能体软件优化不仅限于底层代码的修改，我们让在 Claude Code 中运行的 Claude Opus 5 针对三个现实世界的计算问题执行以下任务：改进现有实现、生成一个更快且全新的现有算法实现，或者完全提出一种新的算法。 每个实现都由领域专家进行了审查，其中包括 openTSNE 和 Orca 的原始开发者，并确认其正确无误。

sents.en: To demonstrate that agentic software optimization extends beyond low-level code changes, we tasked Claude Opus 5, running in Claude Code, with either improving an existing implementation, producing a new, faster implementation of an existing algorithm, or producing a novel algorithm altogether for three real-world computational problems.
sents.zh: 为了证明智能体软件优化不仅限于底层代码的修改，我们让在 Claude Code 中运行的 Claude Opus 5 针对三个现实世界的计算问题执行以下任务：改进现有实现、生成一个更快且全新的现有算法实现，或者完全提出一种新的算法。

sents.en: Each implementation was reviewed by domain experts, including the original developers of openTSNE and Orca, and verified to be correct.
sents.zh: 每个实现都由领域专家进行了审查，其中包括 openTSNE 和 Orca 的原始开发者，并确认其正确无误。

paragraphs.en: t t -distributed stochastic neighbor embedding ( t t -SNE) ( 13 ) is widely used for visualizing high-dimensional data. Because its exact computation scales quadratically with the number of data points, practical applications rely on approximations. The two most widely used approximations are Barnes–Hut, which reduces the asymptotic complexity to 𝒪 ⁡ ( N ​ log ⁡ N ) \mathcal{O}(N\log N) , and FIt-SNE, which further reduces it to 𝒪 ⁡ ( N ) \mathcal{O}(N) .
paragraphs.zh: t t -分布随机邻居嵌入（t t -SNE）(13) 被广泛用于高维数据的可视化。 由于其精确计算的计算量随数据点数量呈二次方增长，实际应用中依赖于近似方法。 两种最广泛使用的近似方法是 Barnes–Hut 算法，它将渐近复杂度降低到 𝒪 ⁡ ( N ​ log ⁡ N ) \mathcal{O}(N\log N)；以及 FIt-SNE 算法，它进一步将其降低到 𝒪 ⁡ ( N ) \mathcal{O}(N)。

sents.en: t t -distributed stochastic neighbor embedding ( t t -SNE) ( 13 ) is widely used for visualizing high-dimensional data.
sents.zh: t t -分布随机邻居嵌入（t t -SNE）(13) 被广泛用于高维数据的可视化。

sents.en: Because its exact computation scales quadratically with the number of data points, practical applications rely on approximations.
sents.zh: 由于其精确计算的计算量随数据点数量呈二次方增长，实际应用中依赖于近似方法。

sents.en: The two most widely used approximations are Barnes–Hut, which reduces the asymptotic complexity to 𝒪 ⁡ ( N ​ log ⁡ N ) \mathcal{O}(N\log N) , and FIt-SNE, which further reduces it to 𝒪 ⁡ ( N ) \mathcal{O}(N) .
sents.zh: 两种最广泛使用的近似方法是 Barnes–Hut 算法，它将渐近复杂度降低到 𝒪 ⁡ ( N ​ log ⁡ N ) \mathcal{O}(N\log N)；以及 FIt-SNE 算法，它进一步将其降低到 𝒪 ⁡ ( N ) \mathcal{O}(N)。

paragraphs.en: openTSNE ( 8 ) implements both approximations and is a mature, highly optimized CPU implementation. We tasked an agent to optimize its optimization phase, which typically accounts for 80–90% of its total runtime, while preserving the public API, parameter defaults, optimization procedure, and accuracy of both approximations. It ran the project’s 174 unit tests after each modification and retained only changes that improved the measured runtime.
paragraphs.zh: openTSNE (8) 实现了两种近似方法，并且是一个成熟且高度优化的 CPU 实现。 我们让一个智能体负责优化其优化阶段——该阶段通常占总运行时间的 80%–90%——同时保留公共 API、默认参数、优化流程以及两种近似方法的准确性。 每次修改后，它都会运行项目的 174 个单元测试，并仅保留那些能缩短测量运行时间的更改。

sents.en: openTSNE ( 8 ) implements both approximations and is a mature, highly optimized CPU implementation.
sents.zh: openTSNE (8) 实现了两种近似方法，并且是一个成熟且高度优化的 CPU 实现。

sents.en: We tasked an agent to optimize its optimization phase, which typically accounts for 80–90% of its total runtime, while preserving the public API, parameter defaults, optimization procedure, and accuracy of both approximations.

sents.en: It ran the project’s 174 unit tests after each modification and retained only changes that improved the measured runtime.
sents.zh: 每次修改后，它都会运行项目的 174 个单元测试，并仅保留那些能缩短测量运行时间的更改。

paragraphs.en: After an overnight run, the optimized implementation was faster in every tested configuration, with speedups of 4.4–7.7 × \times at 500,000 points. Single-threaded runtime decreased from 62 to 8 minutes for Barnes–Hut and from 9 to 2 minutes for FIt-SNE. On eight threads, the corresponding runtimes decreased from 12 to under 2 minutes and from 140 to 28 seconds (Figure 1 .a).
paragraphs.zh: 经过一夜的运行，优化后的实现方案在所有测试配置中均表现出更快的速度，在 500,000 个数据点时，加速倍数达到了 4.4–7.7 × \times。 Barnes–Hut 的单线程运行时间从 62 分钟减少到 8 分钟，FIt-SNE 的单线程运行时间则从 9 分钟减少到 2 分钟。 在八线程环境下，相应的运行时间分别从 12 分钟减少到不到 2 分钟，以及从 140 秒减少到 28 秒（图 1 .a）。

sents.en: After an overnight run, the optimized implementation was faster in every tested configuration, with speedups of 4.4–7.7 × \times at 500,000 points.
sents.zh: 经过一夜的运行，优化后的实现方案在所有测试配置中均表现出更快的速度，在 500,000 个数据点时，加速倍数达到了 4.4–7.7 × \times。

sents.en: Single-threaded runtime decreased from 62 to 8 minutes for Barnes–Hut and from 9 to 2 minutes for FIt-SNE.
sents.zh: Barnes–Hut 的单线程运行时间从 62 分钟减少到 8 分钟，FIt-SNE 的单线程运行时间则从 9 分钟减少到 2 分钟。

sents.en: On eight threads, the corresponding runtimes decreased from 12 to under 2 minutes and from 140 to 28 seconds (Figure 1 .a).
sents.zh: 在八线程环境下，相应的运行时间分别从 12 分钟减少到不到 2 分钟，以及从 140 秒减少到 28 秒（图 1 .a）。

paragraphs.en: The agent implemented and evaluated approximately 60 optimization ideas, retaining 34. The improvements included low-level optimizations such as specialized code paths, improved memory layout, and additional parallelism. The agent also derived a mathematical simplification of one stage of the FIt-SNE approximation, reducing the runtime of that stage by about a quarter. None changed the overall asymptotic complexity. This demonstrates that substantial gains can still be obtained through constant-factor optimization of mature software implementations.
paragraphs.zh: 该智能体实现了并评估了大约 60 个优化方案，最终保留了 34 个。 这些改进包括底层优化，例如专用代码路径、优化的内存布局以及额外的并行处理。 该智能体还推导出了 FIt-SNE 近似算法中某一阶段的数学简化形式，使该阶段的运行时间减少了约四分之一。 这些改进均未改变整体的渐近复杂度。 这表明，通过对成熟的软件实现进行常数因子优化，仍然可以获得显著的效率提升。

paragraphs.en: Gene set enrichment analysis (GSEA) tests whether predefined groups of genes, such as biological pathways, are concentrated at the top or bottom of a list of genes ranked by differential expression. Single-sample GSEA (ssGSEA) ( 1 ) applies this idea to individual samples, scoring every gene set in every sample and thereby converting a gene expression matrix into a matrix of gene set activities. ssGSEA has become a standard step in gene expression analysis, routinely used to estimate cell-type composition and to stratify samples into molecular subtypes.
paragraphs.zh: 基因集富集分析（GSEA）用于检验预定义的基因组（例如生物通路）是否集中在按差异表达水平排序的基因列表的顶部或底部。 单样本 GSEA（ssGSEA）（ 1 ）将这一方法应用于单个样本，为每个样本中的每一个基因集打分，从而将基因表达矩阵转换为基因集活性矩阵。ssGSEA 已成为基因表达分析的标准步骤，通常用于估算细胞类型组成并将样本分为分子亚型。

sents.en: Gene set enrichment analysis (GSEA) tests whether predefined groups of genes, such as biological pathways, are concentrated at the top or bottom of a list of genes ranked by differential expression.
sents.zh: 基因集富集分析（GSEA）用于检验预定义的基因组（例如生物通路）是否集中在按差异表达水平排序的基因列表的顶部或底部。

sents.en: Single-sample GSEA (ssGSEA) ( 1 ) applies this idea to individual samples, scoring every gene set in every sample and thereby converting a gene expression matrix into a matrix of gene set activities. ssGSEA has become a standard step in gene expression analysis, routinely used to estimate cell-type composition and to stratify samples into molecular subtypes.
sents.zh: 单样本 GSEA（ssGSEA）（ 1 ）将这一方法应用于单个样本，为每个样本中的每一个基因集打分，从而将基因表达矩阵转换为基因集活性矩阵。ssGSEA 已成为基因表达分析的标准步骤，通常用于估算细胞类型组成并将样本分为分子亚型。

paragraphs.en: Existing implementations focus on accelerating the scoring of individual sample–gene set pairs. GSEApy implements a fast kernel but still requires a pass over all ranked genes of the sample. GSVA uses a closed-form expression that needs only the ranks of the set’s own genes, reducing asymptotic complexity in theory, but not realizing this gain in its implementation. We tasked an agent with producing a new implementation of ssGSEA, requiring its scores to exactly match those of existing libraries.
paragraphs.zh: 现有的实现方法主要集中在加速单个样本-基因集对的评分上。 GSEApy 实现了一种快速内核，但仍然需要遍历该样本的所有排序基因。 GSVA 使用一种闭式表达式，仅需该基因集自身基因的排名，理论上降低了渐近复杂度，但其实现并未真正体现出这种效率提升。 我们让一个智能体负责生成 ssGSEA 的新实现，并要求其评分必须与现有库的评分完全一致。

sents.en: Existing implementations focus on accelerating the scoring of individual sample–gene set pairs.
sents.zh: 现有的实现方法主要集中在加速单个样本-基因集对的评分上。

sents.en: GSEApy implements a fast kernel but still requires a pass over all ranked genes of the sample.
sents.zh: GSEApy 实现了一种快速内核，但仍然需要遍历该样本的所有排序基因。

sents.en: GSVA uses a closed-form expression that needs only the ranks of the set’s own genes, reducing asymptotic complexity in theory, but not realizing this gain in its implementation.
sents.zh: GSVA 使用一种闭式表达式，仅需该基因集自身基因的排名，理论上降低了渐近复杂度，但其实现并未真正体现出这种效率提升。

sents.en: We tasked an agent with producing a new implementation of ssGSEA, requiring its scores to exactly match those of existing libraries.
sents.zh: 我们让一个智能体负责生成 ssGSEA 的新实现，并要求其评分必须与现有库的评分完全一致。

paragraphs.en: Building on GSVA’s closed form, the agent restructured the computation as a sparse matrix multiplication and eliminated inefficiencies, realizing this asymptotic gain. For 2,000 gene sets scored across 1,000 samples, the runtime decreased from 5 minutes with GSEApy, the fastest existing implementation, to 2.2 seconds, a speedup of 136 × \times , with the gap widening with increasing numbers of gene sets (Figure 1 .b). This makes it practical to score entire gene set collections rather than a preselected subset of pathways, removing a trade-off that analysts routinely make for computational reasons.
paragraphs.zh: 基于 GSVA 的闭式解，该智能体将计算重构为稀疏矩阵乘法并消除了低效环节，从而实现了这种渐近性能提升。 对于在 1,000 个样本中评分的 2,000 个基因集，运行时间从使用现有最快实现 GSEApy 时的 5 分钟缩短至 2.2 秒，速度提升了 136 倍（\times），且随着基因集数量的增加，这一差距进一步拉大（图 1.b）。 这使得对完整的基因集集合进行评分成为可能，而无需局限于预先选定的通路子集，从而消除了分析师出于计算原因通常不得不做出的权衡。

sents.en: Building on GSVA’s closed form, the agent restructured the computation as a sparse matrix multiplication and eliminated inefficiencies, realizing this asymptotic gain.
sents.zh: 基于 GSVA 的闭式解，该智能体将计算重构为稀疏矩阵乘法并消除了低效环节，从而实现了这种渐近性能提升。

sents.zh: 对于在 1,000 个样本中评分的 2,000 个基因集，运行时间从使用现有最快实现 GSEApy 时的 5 分钟缩短至 2.2 秒，速度提升了 136 倍（\times），且随着基因集数量的增加，这一差距进一步拉大（图 1.b）。

sents.en: This makes it practical to score entire gene set collections rather than a preselected subset of pathways, removing a trade-off that analysts routinely make for computational reasons.

paragraphs.en: Graphlets ( 10 ) are small connected graphs that occur as induced subgraphs of a network and can characterize its local topology. Counting the different roles that nodes can occupy within graphlets, known as orbits, provides a finer-grained description of node topology. Graphlet and orbit counts have been widely used in network analysis, including for node classification, anomaly detection, and recommendation. Because the number of subgraphs around a node grows rapidly with its degree, brute-force enumeration quickly becomes infeasible for large or dense networks.
paragraphs.zh: 图小图（10）是作为网络诱导子图出现的小型连通图，能够表征网络的局部拓扑结构。 统计节点在图小图中可占据的不同角色（称为轨道），可以为节点拓扑提供更精细的描述。 图小图和轨道的计数已被广泛用于网络分析，包括节点分类、异常检测和推荐等任务。 由于节点周围的子图数量会随其度数的增加而迅速增长，因此对于大型或密集的网络而言，暴力枚举很快就会变得不可行。

sents.zh: 图小图（10）是作为网络诱导子图出现的小型连通图，能够表征网络的局部拓扑结构。

sents.en: Counting the different roles that nodes can occupy within graphlets, known as orbits, provides a finer-grained description of node topology.
sents.zh: 统计节点在图小图中可占据的不同角色（称为轨道），可以为节点拓扑提供更精细的描述。

sents.zh: 图小图和轨道的计数已被广泛用于网络分析，包括节点分类、异常检测和推荐等任务。

sents.en: Because the number of subgraphs around a node grows rapidly with its degree, brute-force enumeration quickly becomes infeasible for large or dense networks.
sents.zh: 由于节点周围的子图数量会随其度数的增加而迅速增长，因此对于大型或密集的网络而言，暴力枚举很快就会变得不可行。

paragraphs.en: Orca ( 3 ) , a widely used orbit-counting method, avoids brute-force enumeration by deriving the counts of larger graphlets from those of smaller ones through combinatorial relations. For graphlets with up to five nodes, this reduces the expected time complexity from 𝒪 ⁡ ( n ​ d 4 ) \mathcal{O}(nd^{4}) to 𝒪 ⁡ ( n ​ d 3 ) \mathcal{O}(nd^{3}) , where n n is the number of nodes and d d the maximum node degree. We tasked an agent with producing a new implementation with improved scaling of orbit counting, requiring its counts to match those of Orca and brute-force enumeration exactly.
paragraphs.zh: Orca ( 3 ) 是一种广泛使用的轨道计数方法，它通过组合关系从较小图元的计数推导出较大图元的计数，从而避免了暴力枚举。 对于最多包含五个节点的图元，这种方法将期望时间复杂度从 𝒪 ⁡ ( n ​ d 4 ) \mathcal{O}(nd^{4}) 降低到 𝒪 ⁡ ( n ​ d 3 ) \mathcal{O}(nd^{3})，其中 n 是节点数量，d 是最大节点度。 我们要求一个智能体生成一种新的实现，以改进轨道计数的扩展性，并要求其计数结果与 Orca 和暴力枚举的结果完全一致。

sents.en: Orca ( 3 ) , a widely used orbit-counting method, avoids brute-force enumeration by deriving the counts of larger graphlets from those of smaller ones through combinatorial relations.
sents.zh: Orca ( 3 ) 是一种广泛使用的轨道计数方法，它通过组合关系从较小图元的计数推导出较大图元的计数，从而避免了暴力枚举。

sents.en: For graphlets with up to five nodes, this reduces the expected time complexity from 𝒪 ⁡ ( n ​ d 4 ) \mathcal{O}(nd^{4}) to 𝒪 ⁡ ( n ​ d 3 ) \mathcal{O}(nd^{3}) , where n n is the number of nodes and d d the maximum node degree.
sents.zh: 对于最多包含五个节点的图元，这种方法将期望时间复杂度从 𝒪 ⁡ ( n ​ d 4 ) \mathcal{O}(nd^{4}) 降低到 𝒪 ⁡ ( n ​ d 3 ) \mathcal{O}(nd^{3})，其中 n 是节点数量，d 是最大节点度。

sents.en: We tasked an agent with producing a new implementation with improved scaling of orbit counting, requiring its counts to match those of Orca and brute-force enumeration exactly.
sents.zh: 我们要求一个智能体生成一种新的实现，以改进轨道计数的扩展性，并要求其计数结果与 Orca 和暴力枚举的结果完全一致。

paragraphs.en: After running autonomously for several hours, the agent produced an entirely new algorithm that was faster than Orca on every tested network. On a human protein--protein interaction network from BioSNAP, 1 1 1 Stanford Biomedical Network Dataset Collection: https://snap.stanford.edu/biodata/datasets/10000/10000-PP-Pathways.html with approximately 22k nodes and 340k edges, the new implementation counted all orbits in 13 seconds, compared with 35 minutes for Orca, a speedup of about 160 × \times . Brute-force enumeration would require an estimated 3.5 days, over 20,000 times longer than the new implementation. On random graphs with 10k nodes, the gap widened with network density, and the runtime grew roughly quartically with the number of edges for brute-force enumeration, cubically for Orca, and quadratically for the agent’s implementation (Figure 1 .c).
paragraphs.zh: 在自主运行数小时后，该智能体生成了一种全新的算法，在所有测试的网络中都比 Orca 更快。 在来自 BioSNAP 的人类蛋白质-蛋白质相互作用网络上（1 1 1 斯坦福生物医学网络数据集集合：https://snap.stanford.edu/biodata/datasets/10000/10000-PP-Pathways.html，包含约 22,000 个节点和 340,000 条边），新实现仅用 13 秒就计算出了所有轨道，而 Orca 需要 35 分钟，速度提升了约 160 倍。 暴力枚举估计需要 3.5 天，比新实现的时间长超过 20,000 倍。 在包含 10,000 个节点的随机图上，随着网络密度的增加，性能差距进一步拉大；对于暴力枚举，运行时间随边数的增长大致呈四次方关系，Orca 为三次方，而该智能体的实现则为二次方（图 1.c）。

sents.zh: 在自主运行数小时后，该智能体生成了一种全新的算法，在所有测试的网络中都比 Orca 更快。

sents.en: On random graphs with 10k nodes, the gap widened with network density, and the runtime grew roughly quartically with the number of edges for brute-force enumeration, cubically for Orca, and quadratically for the agent’s implementation (Figure 1 .c).
sents.zh: 在包含 10,000 个节点的随机图上，随着网络密度的增加，性能差距进一步拉大；对于暴力枚举，运行时间随边数的增长大致呈四次方关系，Orca 为三次方，而该智能体的实现则为二次方（图 1.c）。

paragraphs.en: Our three case studies demonstrate that autonomous LLM-based agents can substantially speed up scientific software, starting from mature and naive implementations alike. The improvements were not limited to surface-level optimizations; agents applied low-level code optimizations, derived mathematical reformulations, and developed an entirely new algorithm for graphlet counting. The resulting implementations were faster in every case study, in some cases by orders of magnitude.
paragraphs.zh: 我们的三个案例研究表明，基于大型语言模型（LLM）的自主智能体能够显著加快科学软件的运行速度，无论是成熟的实现还是初步的实现都能从中受益。 这些改进并不仅限于表层优化；智能体还应用了底层代码优化，推导出数学上的重新表述，并为图元计数开发了一种全新的算法。 在所有案例研究中，最终的实现方案都更快，某些情况下甚至快了几个数量级。

sents.en: Our three case studies demonstrate that autonomous LLM-based agents can substantially speed up scientific software, starting from mature and naive implementations alike.
sents.zh: 我们的三个案例研究表明，基于大型语言模型（LLM）的自主智能体能够显著加快科学软件的运行速度，无论是成熟的实现还是初步的实现都能从中受益。

sents.en: The resulting implementations were faster in every case study, in some cases by orders of magnitude.
sents.zh: 在所有案例研究中，最终的实现方案都更快，某些情况下甚至快了几个数量级。

paragraphs.en: These findings suggest that software optimization can increasingly be delegated to autonomous agents. Improvements of this kind have typically required specialists in numerical computing or algorithm design, whom most scientific projects cannot afford. Autonomous agents put them within reach of individual researchers and small research groups. The human role is therefore shifting from implementing optimizations to deciding which software to optimize, defining scope and objectives, providing verification mechanisms, and ensuring that the final software is correct. Although problems with open-ended objectives or hard-to-verify correctness remain untested, we argue that for well-scoped, verifiable problems, manual software optimization may indeed be a thing of the past.
paragraphs.zh: 这些发现表明，软件优化工作可以越来越多地委托给自主智能体。 以往这类改进通常需要数值计算或算法设计领域的专家，而大多数科研项目都无力承担聘请他们的费用。 自主智能体使这些改进成为个体研究人员和小型研究团队能够触及的领域。 因此，人类的角色正从执行优化转向决定哪些软件需要优化、界定范围与目标、提供验证机制，并确保最终软件的正确性。 尽管具有开放目标或难以验证正确性的问题尚未得到检验，但我们认为，对于范围明确且可验证的问题而言，手动进行软件优化或许确实已成为过去。
